name: zkapi
title: zkapi · private API credits on Ethereum
description: The Ethereum zkAPI framework (vbuterin/zkapi, Open Anonymity + Ethereum Foundation) as a mod: pay for metered APIs from an ETH vault deposit without the server learning which deposit is yours. Runs the real upstream stack unmodified from a pinned checkout (ZkApiVault + Groth16 verifier + Poseidon on a persistent anvil devnet, zkapi serverd, zkapi-indexerd, zkapi-challenged, the zkapi-browser wallet core) with an OpenRouter-compatible lease provider and a Chainlink-shaped price feed fed by the live mainnet ETH/USD answer; verifies the live mainnet and Sepolia deployments against the SDK pins, operator manifest, on-chain code hashes and local proving keys; exposes deposit / proof-paid chat / withdraw / escape over an API, an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and a web app.

env.ZKAPI_API_TOKEN: bearer token for operator actions from non-loopback callers
env.ZKAPI_UPSTREAM_BASE / ZKAPI_UPSTREAM_KEY: OpenAI-compatible upstream for real inference behind devnet leases (makes devnet actions operator-only)
env.ZKAPI_DEVNET_PRICE: fixed ETH/USD for the devnet feed (default: live Chainlink mainnet answer)
env.ZKAPI_ETH_PRIVATE_KEY: funded key for live (mainnet/sepolia) deposits/withdrawals via m zkapi/live
env.ZKAPI_AGENT_EDIT: open (default: anyone may edit agents on the echo devnet) | owner
env.ZKAPI_AGENT_URL: orbit/claudecode base for the claude brain (default http://127.0.0.1:51260)
